items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I play with Tom too, Tom Brown.

ctx.x: And whose band is it? You know Joe Maxey? I know him, yes, I met him. Trombone, I know him. Well, this is the original WPA band, in fact it was the EO Ray band before the WPA.
I play with Tom too, Tom Brown.

Why don't you find some of those old records and show Dick's hair? By the back and so on. Your uncle went away, Jules, went away with Tom Brown? I think that's when he left around 1918, when my sister was born, my third sister. And I remember I was little, I was about four, I guess. And I remember he came to the house to say goodbye. And he never did come back. I mean, he came here in 65 in the hurricane. And he played on the guitar for us. That ain't good.
